newsitem.title: GREECE: COMMERCIAL BANK/GREECE POSTS 54PCT DROP IN 96 PRETAX.
newsitem.headline: COMMERCIAL BANK/GREECE POSTS 54PCT DROP IN 96 PRETAX.

text.p: Commercial Bank of Greece posted a 54 percent drop in pretax earnings to 12.07 billion drachmas in 1996 from 26.23 billion in 1995, its chairman Constantine Georgoutsakos told the general shareholders meeting.
Commercial's consolidated pretax profits fell to 25.45 billion in 1996 from 45.24 billion in 1995, he said.
"Operating expenses grew 15.2 percent in 1996 from 22.3 percent in 1995 and 23.3 percent in 1994," said Georgoutsakos.
Commercial Bank set aside 8.69 billion drachmas for loan loss provisions in 1996 from 6.17 billion in 1995. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
